headword: {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}

definitions.explanation: meeting place; assembly point; the designated location where people gather before an activity

examples.japanese: {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧です。
examples.english: The meeting place is in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm the meeting place and time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{校庭|こうてい}→校庭：04147_koutei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The evacuation assembly point is set as the school grounds.

notes:
{集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ} is a compound noun combining ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧ (assembly, gathering) + ⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (place). It's used for any designated meeting point.

USAGE:
- ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧や⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧ (field trips and school trips)
- ⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧ (guided tours)
- ⟦{避難訓練|ひなんくんれん}→避難訓練：28230_hinankunren⟧ (evacuation drills)
- ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (group activities)
- ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧ (events)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧ (to gather at the meeting place)
- {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to decide the meeting place)
- {集合場所|しゅうごうばしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (to be late to the meeting place)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせる：12328_machiawaseru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (meeting/rendezvous spot - more casual)
- ⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (assembly time)
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧ (evacuation site)

REGISTER: Neutral. Standard vocabulary for organized activities.
